name: Pipian
source:
Department of Thermodynamics (specialty in refrigeration), Maid club; Mythical Therio: Dragon

An undergrad student who wears a maid outfit purely as a hobby. Can handle the cold.

An undergrad maid dragon who considers herself a dinosaur Therio. Freezes whatever drink she's holding when nervous.
